definitions.gloss: regular medication; daily medicine; routine prescription
definitions.explanation: Medicine taken on a regular or ongoing basis, typically for the management of chronic conditions such as high blood pressure, diabetes, or allergies.

examples.japanese: {常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: I always bring my regular medication when traveling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、{常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When being admitted to the hospital, please submit a list of your regular medications to the doctor.

notes:
Composed of {常用|じょうよう} (regular use, habitual use) and {薬|やく} (medicine). An important practical term for anyone managing health care in Japan, frequently encountered at hospitals, pharmacies, and when filling out medical forms. Knowing this word is essential for medical visits and hospital stays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take one's regular medication
- {常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: list of regular medications
- {常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧: to bring one's regular medication
- {常用薬|じょうようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change one's regular medication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{処方薬|しょほうやく}→処方薬：18860_shohouyaku⟧: prescription medicine — medicine prescribed by a doctor; may be temporary or ongoing
- ⟦{市販薬|しはんやく}→市販薬：09834_shihanyaku⟧: over-the-counter medicine — medicine available without a prescription
- ⟦{頓服薬|とんぷくやく}→頓服薬：26175_tonpukuyaku⟧: medicine taken as needed — taken only when symptoms appear, not on a regular schedule
